description: Phase 3E. Exercises the WASM kill-switch publisher-key delta refresh path and the locked-at-3E `no_unloaded_module_appears_in_diagnostics` invariant. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate and loads `hello-https` (slug + sha256_prefix `a1b2c3d4`). Day 3 the rig publishes a signed kill-switch delta (generation 1) covering the loaded module's sha256; the engine refreshes via the existing pointer-rotation refresh path, verifies the delta, and inserts the (sha256) into the kill-switch set. Day 7 `wasm_kill_switched_count` MUST be ≥ 1; `loaded_wasm_modules` MUST NOT contain the killed module; the killed sha256 prefix MUST NOT surface anywhere in diagnostics (canonical regression). Day 10 the rig loads a DIFFERENT unkilled module (`hello-tls`, sha256 prefix `f1f2f3f4`); the load MUST succeed (kill-switch is per-module, not blanket); `loaded_wasm_modules` surfaces only `hello-tls`. Day 14 the rig clears modules; `loaded_wasm_modules` clears to `[]`; the kill-switch entry persists in `secrets_kv:wasm_killed:<sha>` so a re-import of the killed module on day N+1 STILL refuses to load. The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
